== Description ==

[[Nathan Davis]] (front left, blue Seattle cap, black hoodie, beard), [[Mike Turner]] (back left, tan eagle cap, black hoodie), [[Ryan Jellison]] (back center, dark brown pullover, glasses, salt-and-pepper wavy hair), [[Amar Banger]] (front right, olive Nike hoodie, hair bun, dark grey beard), and [[Chris Schoenthal]] (far back right at laptop, maroon KTOD hoodie, black cap, long ginger beard, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
